study.question: Which omitted first-order history information accounts for the compact representation gap: category/brand means, finer recency, or their interaction? Can restoring only these means through histogram context projection retain joint_identity utility at lower measured cost?
study.hypothesis: Observed: baseline-static/pooled/din AUCs are 0.6050036/0.6102261/0.6133620; frozen g1-r0012-joint_identity is 0.62042594. The g2-r0012 compact_summary and compact_matched implementations reach 0.61912940 and 0.61951803 while reducing train time from 548.36s to 411.17/411.22s and peak GPU allocation from 720559616 to 387421696/387794432 bytes. Capacity matching recovers only 0.00038863 AUC. Compact_matched loses 0.00090791 AUC overall and 0.00116049 in history_gt64 (3026583 impressions,151372 positives,2875211 negatives), whereas history_17_64 is essentially equal; these are exploratory selected-model observations, not proof of a long-history mechanism. Compact_pair_fold changes AUC by +0.00004650, while reference_pair_fold changes it by -0.00030864; single-seed differences and a deterministic partial permutation do not establish event binding. Source inspection shows compact summaries removed learned category/brand identity means AND log2-age detail, together with independent moments and the global norm block. Hypothesis: the joint reference needs some of the omitted first-order means, without needing its larger moment/norm readout. A 2x2 restoration isolates content versus fine recency, with an always-active context block and equal allocated/active parameter counts across cells. Histogram-first action/age projection avoids all learned per-event context tensors. This is a local sufficiency/implementation hypothesis, not a novelty or event-binding claim.

nearest_work.difference: Primary text describes embedding/mean pooling and target-aware local activation. We inherit embedding/MLP and first-order pooling, replacing learned attention with four existing exact target-match groups, keeping local scalar summaries and using count-space context projection. This is not an exact DIN reproduction and pooling is established prior work.

nearest_work.difference: Author README confirms category, brand and behavior type histories without item identities. We do not invent item/user-match supervision; publisher full text is unavailable in the registry, so detailed DMR mechanism differences remain unverified.

The both-on cell restores only four additive group means. It omits independent content-context products and global field contrast-energy/direction. Fine context means are algebraically reproduced from grouped action and log2-age counts. Sorted category/brand/pair entropy and collision features remain exact.

Eight scalar/identity helper methods are copied verbatim. Add one 4x16 mean block, cross content on/off with fine/coarse recency, and analytically adjust first hidden width to match the joint reference active nonstatic parameter count. The coarse/off cell re-encodes already visible summaries and controls new coordinates, parameters, and context parameterization. Existing compact_matched is an additional capacity-count reference, not a same-initialization contrast.

External unified sequence/field summaries and system-level evidence were reviewed. No transport gates, query generator, long/local branch, token scaling, FM highway, new optimizer or auxiliary supervision is adopted. The present change comes from local source omissions and outcomes; source pCVR and domains do not establish transfer or novelty.

inherited_components: Frozen input identities, causal histories, sample coverage, natural prevalence, scorer, epochs=3, batch=4096, history_limit=128, scratch seed42 and host optimizer/loss.
Static 16-dimensional field embeddings and their shared category/brand tables; original four target-match groups with zero/missing excluded as matches.
Exact 4 log-count statistics, 64 group/action/coarse-age log-counts, 28 complete-support identity entropy/collision features and zero-final-initialized bias-free 28-to16-to1 identity head.
The eight inherited scalar/identity helper ASTs and sorted O(BL) storage calculations are unchanged; quadratic identity code is diagnostics-only.
Established first-order masked embedding means, action table5x16 and log2-age table33x16; no attention or per-event nonlinear scorer.
study.proposed_difference: A four-cell factorial: pooled_both=(content pooled,fine recency), pooled_content=(content pooled,coarse recency), fine_context=(content off,fine recency), coarse_reencode=(content off,coarse recency). Every cell allocates identical parameter shapes/order and returns the same-width static+4x16means+68scalars representation plus the unchanged identity residual. Action and log2-age means are computed by scatter-count histograms followed by small matrix products. Fine means equal the reference per-event context mean within floating precision. Coarse recency reconstructs fine counts from existing four coarse-age counts via a fixed row-stochastic map: equal mass over each log2 bin intersecting the given coarse interval; no population fitting. It has no new input information, including at bucket/interval boundaries. Category/brand means are added to context means only in content-on cells. At the observed F=18, all four cells have first_hidden=158 and 77831 active nonstatic parameters, versus 77617 in the frozen reference (+214,0.276%); static embeddings match exactly. This matches nominal count, not function class, gradient support or optimization. The coarse recency map is a parameterization control, not a calibrated fine-age estimate. No within-event content/context products or new event-pair interactions are introduced.
predictions: Predeclared paired content contrasts: pooled_both minus fine_context and pooled_content minus coarse_reencode should recover utility if learned history content identities are consequential.

Predeclared paired recency contrasts: pooled_both minus pooled_content and fine_context minus coarse_reencode should improve if discarded fine recency is consequential; both may be null. Difference of these effects diagnoses interaction, with uncertainty and functional-capacity caveats.

Utility-retention target set before new outcomes: candidate-minus-joint_identity mean validation AUC >= -0.0003, paired across seeds42/43/44 when feasible. A single-seed pass is screening only. When paired user-cluster intervals are supported by the host, require the lower bound above -0.0003 before inferential noninferiority language; otherwise report means/ranges as preliminary. Logloss and all slices are reported separately.

Efficiency target: at least 10% lower measured training seconds OR 10% lower inference p95 than joint_identity under the fixed full-data recipe, alongside the utility target. Report wall/GPU allocation, examples, peak memory, throughput and both latencies; no inference-speed claim follows from training speed. Fixed-pass cost is not an equal-compute comparison.

Host diagnostics should verify histogram/context algebra, mass preservation, padding/empty/reversal invariance and exact scalar lineage. Folded category-brand pairing should preserve learned first-order means and nonidentity features but may change the joint identity residual inputs. These are implementation checks on 512 rows, not mechanism proof.
falsifiers: A gap larger than 0.0003 AUC after repetition rejects utility retention by this implementation, even if cheaper; it does not prove compression impossible.

Both content contrasts near zero or negative weaken the learned-content explanation; both fine/coarse contrasts near zero or negative weaken the fine-recency explanation. A gain confined to coarse_reencode versus old compact suggests parameterization/optimization rather than restored information.
If only the both-on cell improves, additive main-effect explanations are inadequate: report the interaction and require further attribution rather than assigning the gain to either component alone.
Failure to meet measured cost target rejects the practical efficiency claim even if predictive utility is recovered.

Nonfinite logits/diagnostics, histogram/direct-context disagreement materially above 5e-5, nonzero empty-history summaries, or alteration of inherited information boundaries invalidates the implementation comparison and requires correction with failed costs retained.
alternative_explanations: One seed, selected best checkpoints and selection over prior trajectories can produce AUC changes; 3234051 impressions are correlated within users. No independent significance follows from the population size.

Equal allocated/active parameter counts do not equate function class. Fine recency admits more independent temporal directions than the coarse map, shared content tables receive different gradient coverage, and added means change optimization and feature scaling.

Old compact versus coarse_reencode also changes first hidden width (183 to158), initial draws after embedding allocation and redundant raw-count parameterization; only within-factorial single-factor comparisons share exact scratch initialization.

The chosen fixed coarse-to-fine map is one coarse re-encoding; a failed coarse cell can reflect that map. Its absence of new information can be proved algebraically, not an optimal no-fine-data baseline.

The first-order pools cannot identify general category-brand event binding; the unchanged 28-coordinate joint identity head still carries pairing information. Previous folded contrasts remain partial deterministic, single-seed evidence.

GPU scheduling, feature-gathering time, caching and batch size affect cost; total allocated embeddings dominate parameter count. Static user/ad snapshot as-of times are undocumented, so conclusions concern the frozen benchmark assumption.

Host diagnostics cover first512 rows and cannot establish population causal utility. Earlier null pairing findings and the lower compact AUC remain in the evidence record; no provided trial failed, and previous_runtime_error is null.
